repos_data.description: This repo includes Claude prompt curation to use Claude better.
A native macOS companion for Claude Code that lets you browse sessions, explore diffs, and re-run commands.
An economical and fuel(token) efficient AI tool, graph session memory for looong chat session
Claude Code plugin — AI-powered autopilot for managing open source contributions. Track PRs, respond to maintainers, discover issues, maintain velocity.
MCP server with persistent memory + FTS5 search for Claude Code conversation history. Index your ~/.claude/projects/, expose 10 MCP tools, browse via web UI. MIT-licensed.

AI Skills, MCP Tools, and CLI for Unity Engine. Full AI develop and test loop. Use cli for quick setup. Efficient token usage, advanced tools. Any C# method may be turned into a tool by a single line. Works with Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor and any other absolutely for free.
Supports GPT Image 2, Seedance & ComfyUI, with a 1,400+ prompt library, carefully crafted hooks and a multi-task orchestration system
MCP server that turns text prompts into premium iOS mobile UI mockups (PNG + HTML). Powered by Claude (Opus 4.7) + Playwright. Two backends: local CLI or Anthropic API. MIT.
Build and publish websites through AI conversation. 27+ MCP tools, OAuth 2.1 auto-discovery. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Mistral/Le Chat, Cursor and more.

Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
